title: Retro game discovery and supplied projects
summary: Review two Atari ST game port projects.
notes: Personally reviewed upstream pinned READMEs. No independent build, gameplay or byte comparison. Screamer and RedCat were removed after current main showed they are already tracked.

sources.reason: Translates the Atari ST program to C and links it to a retained small STE machine runtime. This is baked emulation despite not interpreting 68000 instructions.

identity.narrative: Pinned README identifies King's Quest V and this project.

classification.narrative: Converts and patches the original Amiga SCI interpreter into an Atari ST program with an AmigaOS/hardware shim and PC EGA art. Compatibility rehosting, not restored interpreter source.

source_cpu.narrative: Documented source platform or executable uses m68k.

build.narrative: The author reports Hatari playtesting through early areas; original Amiga and DOS game data are required. No independent build, execution, gameplay or byte comparison was performed.

runtime_profiles.narrative: No independently verified minimum hardware profile.

ai.narrative: Claude collaboration is disclosed in the upstream README or commit.

relationships.narrative: Distinct from the tracked King's Quest VI AGI demake repair; this uses the King's Quest V Amiga interpreter and PC artwork. Previous deferral resolved as compatibility rehosting, not restored interpreter source.
